background: Bank of America Corporation is the holding company of the second-largest US bank, spanning consumer banking, wealth management under Merrill and a global corporate and investment bank.
synthesis: Rated A+ on average across all three, the weakest of them at A-, all three on a stable outlook, the last move a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 3 May 2023. Capital is the weak spot against US banks, with CET1 of 11.2% in the bottom quarter and leverage of 5.5% below the peer median. LCR of 112% is just below the median, and none of the ratios has moved materially over the past four periods to 30 Sep 2026. The ratings rest on the scale and diversity of the franchise more than on a capital cushion.
